news.title: Kirkland Advises Tract Capital on Lease and Purchase and Sale for Hyperscale Data Center Development | News | Kirkland & Ellis LLP

facts: Kirkland & Ellis advised Tract Capital funds on lease and purchase and sale of real property for a 230 MW data center and substation in Storey County, Nevada
The project has been 100% leased to a AA- investment grade rated tenant under a 197-month triple net lease
